inputs.event_requirement: >=3 in, >=10 out, >=3 out on each side
inputs.quality: QUALITY == 0 and finite flux in all valid pixels

notes: diff_centroid_* is the specified estimator (3x3 box around the brightest difference pixel by flux). Per quarter the brightest pixel is often a noise excursion in the target's core (its S/N is listed as brightest_diff_pixel_snr), so this estimator is bimodal; its bootstrap/MC covariance and the multi_quarter_mean_offset built from it are not reliable. snrbox_* uses the same 3x3 flux-weighted centroid boxed on the highest-S/N difference pixel.

two_source_fit uses a Gaussian PSF (not the Kepler PRF) with both stars at their Gaia/WCS positions; it is an approximate check, implied depth = fitted difference amplitude / fitted direct amplitude of the same star.
